title: The minutes have been circulated
body: The minutes of this month's meeting record an action against your name. Nobody remembers agreeing it, including the person who wrote it down. It is due on Friday.

title: Your figures have been presented
body: Priya has shown your figures to the floor above, with one small improvement: Priya's name is now in the corner where yours was. An email thanks the team for its support.

title: FW: Monthly Status Report OVERDUE
body: Dennis has forwarded you a chaser about the report you did not file while you were at the pub with Dennis. The whole message reads: Thoughts?

title: Thanks for your input
body: Your Monthly Status Report has gone upstairs under Dennis's name, as an executive summary of your Monthly Status Report. The summary is your report.

title: You hear your phrase on the way up
body: Dennis is explaining strategic patience to someone from the fifth floor, and is doing so as its author. You are holding the door.
